title: Sheaf cohomology is the filtered hypercover-Cech cohomology functor

standard_prerequisites.name: Explicit prerequisite boundary
standard_prerequisites.reference: Stable Stacks tags retained in assembly.external_references
standard_prerequisites.use: Sites with fibre products, semi-representable objects, simplicial matching/coskeleton constructions, local annihilation of higher sheaf-cohomology classes and filtered colimits. The hypercover refinement andCech spectral-sequence proofs are retained.

core_obligations: Represent a sheaf-cohomology class by a hypercoverCech class by eliminating the successive spectral-sequence obstructions through suitable refinements.
For aCech class mapping to zero, refine again to annihilate the higher-differential witnesses, proving injectivity and functoriality of the comparison.

proof_roadmap.step: Represent a sheaf-cohomology class by a hypercoverCech class by eliminating the successive spectral-sequence obstructions through suitable refinements.
For aCech class mapping to zero, refine again to annihilate the higher-differential witnesses, proving injectivity and functoriality of the comparison.

difficulty_reason: The result requires choosing refinements that kill obstructions in the correct successive bidegrees, in both surjectivity and injectivity directions. This is more than applying a fixed-cover spectral sequence and supports H2.

compared.difference: This migrates the existing unpublished research record, not an additional count beside it.
